movie_title_jp: 響け！情熱のムリダンガム
director: ラージーブ・メーナン
country: インド 原題または英題：Sarvam Thaala Mayam
synopsis: インド伝統音楽の打楽器「ムリダンガム」の奏者を目指す青年の奮闘を描いた青春音楽映画。 インドのチェンナイで暮らすムリダンガム職人の息子ピーターは、父が作ったムリダンガムを巨匠が演奏するのを見たことがきっかけで、自身もその奏者になりたいと思うように。巨匠に弟子入りし修行に励むピーターは、カースト差別や伝統芸能の継承に伴う軋轢、世代間の意見の違いなど様々な困難にぶつかりながらも、情熱と敬意をもって立ち向かっていく。 「スラムドッグ＄ミリオネア」でアカデミー作曲賞を受賞したA・R・ラフマーンが音楽を手がけ、ラフマーンの甥で映画音楽の作曲家としても知られるG・V・プラカーシュ・クマールが主人公ピーターを演じた。2018年・第31回東京国際映画祭ワールド・フォーカス部門では、「世界はリズムで満ちている」のタイトルで上映。2022年10月の劇場公開に際しては、本作にほれ込んだ南インド料理店「なんどり」（東京・荒川区）が配給した。
tmdb_overview_en: Peter who tries to find his place in the world of classical Indian music embarks on a journey that helps him evolve personally, spiritually and musically.
synopsis_en: A youth music film about a young man's struggle to become a player of the mridangam, a traditional Indian percussion instrument. Peter, the son of a mridangam craftsman living in Chennai, India, is inspired to become a player himself after seeing a master perform on a mridangam his father made. Apprenticing under the master and training diligently, Peter faces various challenges including caste discrimination, conflicts over preserving traditional arts, and generational differences, but confronts them with passion and respect. The music is composed by A. R. Rahman, who won an Academy Award for 'Slumdog Millionaire.' G. V. Prakash Kumar, Rahman's nephew and a renowned film music composer, plays the protagonist Peter. Screened under the title 'The World Is Full of Rhythms' in the World Focus section of the 31st Tokyo International Film Festival in 2018. For its theatrical release in October 2022, the film was distributed by 'Nandori,' a South Indian restaurant in Tokyo's Arakawa Ward that fell in love with the film.

synopsis: 「私の一生は一篇の童話であった」というアンデルセンの言葉から着想を得た音楽劇で、「赤い靴」や「親指姫」などの童話を織り交ぜながらアンデルセンの少年時代を描く。夜空には色とりどりの星が輝き、オーケストラの音色が物語を包む。小山礼司の美術と宇野誠一郎の音楽が、メルヘンの世界を甘美に表現している。
tmdb_overview_jp: 童話作家になるのが夢のハンス少年のもとに、眠りの精オーレおじさん（Ole）がやってくる。アンデルセン童話の有名な「マッチ売りの少女」や、「親指姫」、「赤い靴」などのエピソードを織り交ぜて、ミュージカル仕立てのストーリーは展開する。
tmdb_overview_en: During his boyhood, young Hans Christian Andersen is exposed to the musical fairy-tale dream world by his Uncle Ole.
movie_title_en: The World of Hans Christian Andersen
synopsis_en: Inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's words, 'My life is a fairy tale,' this musical drama weaves together tales like 'The Red Shoes' and 'Thumbelina' while depicting Andersen's boyhood. The night sky sparkles with colorful stars, and the orchestra's melodies envelop the story. The art by Reiji Koyama and the music by Seiichiro Uno sweetly bring this fairy-tale world to life.

synopsis: 重厚なドラマを求めた東映本社幹部陣により、田中澄江が脚本に招かれた。貴族の姉弟が奴隷に身を落とし、その受難を立身出世によって克服する物語に対し、アニメーターたちは社会の権力構造にあまりに無自覚であると強く反発したが、背景と人物が見事に調和した大和絵のような映像は息を呑む美しさを湛えている。
tmdb_overview_en: After their father quarrels with local military men, Anju and Zushio are forced to flee, but they are captured and sold into slavery. When their mother dies, they are sold to Sansho the Bailiff, a cruel man who subjects them to hideous torments. While Anju falls into a lake and is transformed into a swan, Zushio escapes and after being adopted to a nobleman grows to a young man. He will then fight to defeat the evil Dayu and free all the slaves.
synopsis_en: Summoned by Toei's top brass seeking a weighty drama, screenwriter Sumie Tanaka was brought on board. The story follows aristocratic siblings reduced to slavery, overcoming their suffering through social advancement. Animators strongly objected to the narrative's obliviousness to societal power structures, yet the breathtakingly beautiful Yamato-e style visuals, where backgrounds and characters harmonize perfectly, captivate the viewer.

country: 日本
synopsis: 直木賞と山本周五郎賞をダブル受賞した永井紗耶子による同名小説を、柄本佑と渡辺謙の初共演で映画化したミステリー時代劇。 時は江戸時代。ある雪の降る夜、木挽町の芝居小屋「森田座」のすぐ近くで、美しい若衆・菊之助が父の仇討ちを見事に成し遂げた。その事件は多くの人々に目撃され、美談として語られることになる。1年半後、菊之助の縁者だという侍・総一郎が、仇討ちの顛末を知りたいと森田座を訪れる。菊之助に関わった人々から事件の経緯を聞くなかで徐々に事実が明らかになり、やがて仇討ちの裏に隠された「秘密」が浮かび上がる。 仇討ち事件の真相を追う田舎侍・加瀬総一郎役で柄本佑が主演を務め、森田座で謀略を巡らせる立作者・篠田金治を渡辺謙が重厚に演じる。仇討ちを成した者・伊納菊之助役で長尾謙杜（なにわ男子）、菊之助の父を手にかけ仇討ちされた無法者・作兵衛役で北村一輝、森田座の木戸芸者・一八役で瀬戸康史、森田座の立師・相良与三郎役で滝藤賢一、女形で衣裳方の芳澤ほたる役で高橋和也、小道具方の久蔵役で正名僕蔵が共演。テレビドラマ「忠臣蔵狂詩曲No.5 中村仲蔵　出世階段」などの時代劇や映画「大停電の夜に」で知られる源孝志が監督・脚本を手がけた。
synopsis_en:
A mystery period drama based on the award-winning novel by Sayako Nagai—recipient of both the Naoki Prize and the Yamamoto Shugoro Prize—marking the first screen collaboration between Tasuku Emoto and Ken Watanabe.

Set in the Edo period, the story begins on a snowy night near the Morita-za theater in Kobikicho, where a beautiful youth named Kikunosuke successfully carries out a revenge killing to avenge his father. Witnessed by many, the event is hailed as a noble tale of justice. A year and a half later, a country samurai named Soichiro Kase, claiming to be a relative of Kikunosuke, arrives at the Morita-za seeking the full story of the incident. As he interviews those connected to Kikunosuke, the facts slowly unravel, eventually exposing a "secret" hidden beneath the surface of the revenge.

Tasuku Emoto stars as Soichiro Kase, the samurai pursuing the truth, while Ken Watanabe delivers a commanding performance as Kinji Shinoda, the head playwright at Morita-za who orchestrates the schemes within the theater. The ensemble cast features Kento Nagao (Naniwa Danshi) as Kikunosuke Ino, the young man who achieved his revenge; Kazuki Kitamura as Sakubee, the outlaw who killed Kikunosuke’s father; Koji Seto as Ippachi, a theater barker; Kenichi Takito as Yosaburo Sagara, the fight choreographer; Kazuya Takahashi as Hotaru Yoshizawa, an *onnagata* actor and costume manager; and Bokuzo Masana as Kyuzo, the prop master. The film is written and directed by Takashi Minamoto, known for the period drama *Chushingura Rhapsody No. 5: Nakamura Nakazo’s Rise to Fame* and the film *Until the Lights Come Back*.

movie_title: 『牛乳屋フランキー』 ＊デジタル上映
synopsis: かいせつ 親戚の牛乳店を手伝うために上京したご陽気な青年が、商売敵に負けじと奮闘する―。人気ラジオドラマの映画化で、スラップスティック・コメディの隠れた名作として知られるフランキー初期の代表作。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_en: Roppeita is big in size, clumsy and full of energy. When his grandfather orders him to move out to Tokyo to save a sinking milk delivery business a distant relative of his runs, he encounters the most strangest of clientele.
synopsis_en: A cheerful young man moves to Tokyo to help at a relative's milk shop and struggles to outdo his business rivals. A film adaptation of a popular radio drama, this is an early representative work of Frankie Sakai, known as a hidden gem of slapstick comedy.

synopsis: かいせつ 「暢気眼鏡」で芥川賞を受賞した尾崎が妻をモデルにした私小説の映画化。妻を“芳兵衛”の愛称で呼ぶ食えない作家の夫(フランキー)と、素朴で愛嬌たっぷりの妻(司)との、貧しくとも幸せな日々を描いた愛すべき1本。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
synopsis_en: A film adaptation of the autobiographical novel by Ozaki, who won the Akutagawa Prize for "Norakuro Megane," with his wife as the model. This endearing film depicts the poor but happy days of a quirky writer husband (Frankie), who calls his wife by the pet name "Yoshihyoe," and his simple, charming wife (Kishi).

synopsis: かいせつ 東京から大阪に向かう特急の車内では、ウェイトレスのサヨ子(団)がコック助手の喜一(フランキー)に結婚を迫っていた―。獅子文六の人気小説の映画化で、食堂車に乗り合わせたクセ強めの乗客たちが巻き起こす騒動を描いた群像喜劇。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_jp: 東京駅発、特急こだま。食堂車ウエイトレスのサヨ子は、コック助手の喜一にプロポーズをする。サヨ子の夢は、喜一と父が昔やっていた弁当屋を大阪で開くことだった。とはいえ喜一は一流ホテルのコックなる夢を捨てられない。さらに華族出身のスチュアデス・有女子が喜一に時々ささやきかけるのが気になる。こだまが終点・大阪に着くまで6時間半。サヨ子は喜一からプロポーズの返事を受け取ることができるのか…。
tmdb_overview_en: Comedy of manners set on the "Kodama" train between Tokyo and Osaka, before the opening of the Shinkansen. In the leading role, Frankie Sakai plays a straightforward but indecisive hero. The passengers also include the bubbly Dan Reiko, and Ozawa Eitaro as a dour company president. Based on the novel "Seven and a half hours", by Shishi Bunroku.
synopsis_en: Aboard an express train from Tokyo to Osaka, waitress Sayoko (Dan) pressures kitchen assistant Kiichi (Frankie) to marry her. An adaptation of a popular novel by Bunroku Shishi, this ensemble comedy depicts the chaos stirred up by a group of eccentric passengers sharing the dining car.

synopsis: かいせつ 東北本線の車掌・吾一(フランキー)は、幼馴染の芸者・さくら（倍賞）に熱烈なアプローチを受けているが、密かに思う女性が…。喜劇の名手・瀬川がメガホンを取り、フランキー主演で全11作が製作された「旅行シリーズ」の第三作。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_jp: 旅行シリーズ第3作。鉄道会社の専務車掌・大野（フランキー堺）は、豪華寝台特急「つばめ」の運行で大忙し。思いを寄せる美女・さくら（佐藤友美）を巡り、嫉妬深い第二の女性・千枝（倍賞千恵子）とドタバタの逆転劇を繰り広げる。
tmdb_overview_en: A drama from director Masaharu Segawa.
synopsis_en: Conductor Goichi (Frankie) on the Tohoku Main Line receives passionate advances from his childhood friend, geisha Sakura (Baisho), but secretly has his eye on another woman. The third installment of the 11-film "Travel Series" starring Frankie Sakai, directed by comedy master Segawa.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1960年代神戸—日本で生まれたベルギー人の小さな女の子アメリ。彼女の成長を描く物語。外交官の家庭に生まれ、2歳半までは無反応状態だったアメリ。その後、子ども時代に突入した彼女は自らを「神」だと信じ、魔法のような世界を生きている。家政婦のニシオさんや家族との日々の生活は、彼女にとって冒険であり、新たな発見の連続。少しずつ変化していくアメリ。しかし、3歳の誕生日に人生を変える出来事が起こり、彼女の世界は大きく変わっていく…。誰もが子供時代に夢見た世界を描く感動のアニメーション作品
tmdb_overview_en: The world is a perplexing, peaceful mystery to Amélie until a miraculous encounter with chocolate ignites her wild sense of curiosity. As she develops a deep attachment to her family's housekeeper, Nishio-san, Amélie discovers the wonders of nature as well as the emotional truths hidden beneath the surface of her family's idyllic life as foreigners in post-war Japan.
movie_title_original: Amélie et la métaphysique des tubes
movie_title_en: Little Amélie or the Character of Rain
synopsis_en: An animated film set in 1960s Kobe, depicting the growth of Amélie, a Belgian girl born in Japan. Based on the autobiographical novel "Tube Metaphysics" by Belgian writer Amélie Nothomb, it portrays a world rich in emotion, seen through the eyes of the two-year-old protagonist Amélie, woven with life, color, and her witty words. In 1960s Kobe, Amélie, a Belgian girl born into a diplomat's family, is unresponsive until age two and a half, but then enters an invincible childhood, believing herself to be a god and living in a magical world. Her days with her beloved housekeeper Nishio and her family are adventures full of new discoveries. One day, she learns the kanji for "rain," which suits her perfectly. Then, on her third birthday, an event occurs that changes everything. Directed by Myriam Ballard and Liang-Cho Han, who worked on "Long Way North," with music by Japanese composer Mari Fukuhara. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Annecy International Animated Film Festival and was nominated for Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.

movie_title: 旅立ちのラストダンス
movie_title_jp: 旅立ちのラストダンス
country: 香港 原題または英題：破．地獄 The Last Dance
synopsis: 「Mr.Boo！」シリーズで日本でも人気を集めた香港の喜劇王マイケル・ホイと、香港を代表するコメディアンで「毒舌弁護人　正義への戦い」など俳優としても活躍するダヨ・ウォンが32年ぶりに共演を果たし、香港映画歴代興行収入第1位を塗り替える大ヒットを記録したヒューマンドラマ。香港の葬儀業界を舞台に、「家族」「伝統」「死生観」といった普遍的なテーマを丁寧に描き出す。 ウエディングプランナーのトウサンはコロナ禍で多額の負債を抱え、やむを得ず葬儀業者に転職するが、結婚式と葬式は大きく異なり、さまざまな困難に直面してしまう。利益を追求したいトウサンに対し、ともに葬儀を取り仕切る厳格な道士・マン師匠は伝統を重んじており、2人は絶えず衝突する。しかしマン師匠やその娘マンユッと関わるうちに、マン師匠に対するトウサンのわだかまりは少しずつ消えていく。やがてトウサンは、マン師匠が葬儀で行う道教の伝統的な儀式「破地獄」の真の意味に気づきはじめる。 葬儀業者トウサンをダヨ・ウォン、マン道士をマイケル・ホイが演じた。監督は、脚本家出身で本作が長編監督第3作となるアンセルム・チャン。2025年・第43回香港電影金像奨で主演女優賞（ミシェル・ワイ）など5部門を受賞した。第37回東京国際映画祭ワールド・フォーカス部門では、「ラスト・ダンス」の邦題で126分のバージョンが上映された。劇場公開は140分のディレクターズカット版。
tmdb_overview_jp: 疫病が猛威をふるい経済が低迷するなか、葬儀社に転職したダオシェン（ダヨ・ウォン）。当初は先輩のマン（マイケル・ホイ）と衝突するダオシェンだったが、彼と仕事をするうちに人生観に変化が生まれていく。ダヨ・ウォンとマイケル・ホイ、香港映画界の二大コメディアンが『マジック・タッチ』（1992）以来32年ぶりに共演とあって、撮影時から大きな話題となっている注目作。「破地獄」とは、故人の霊を地獄から救い出すための道教の儀式を意味している。
tmdb_overview_en: Despite the pandemic sending most industries into recession, debt-ridden wedding planner Dominic (Dayo WONG) gets a miraculous chance to turn things around when a funeral planner retires and passes the baton to him. His creative gimmicks for funerals help his business find unexpected success, but Dominic’s biggest obstacle is winning the approval of respected and sternly traditional Taoist priest, Master Man (Michael HUI). After some unordinary funerals, Dominic gradually understands Master Man’s code of ethics and the meaning behind each farewell.
clean_title_jp: 旅立ちのラストダンス
synopsis_en: A human drama reuniting Hong Kong comedy king Michael Hui, popular in Japan for the 'Mr. Boo!' series, and Dayo Wong, a top Hong Kong comedian and actor ('A Witness Out of the Blue'), after 32 years. It became a massive hit, breaking Hong Kong's all-time box office record. Set in Hong Kong's funeral industry, it carefully explores universal themes of family, tradition, and views on life and death. Wedding planner To-sang, burdened with debt from the pandemic, reluctantly switches to the funeral business but faces difficulties as weddings and funerals are vastly different. To-sang, focused on profit, constantly clashes with the strict Taoist priest Master Man, who values tradition. However, as To-sang interacts with Master Man and his daughter Man-yuet, his resentment gradually fades. He begins to understand the true meaning of the traditional Taoist ritual 'Breaking Hell' that Master Man performs at funerals. Dayo Wong plays funeral director To-sang, and Michael Hui plays Taoist Master Man. Director Anselm Chan, a screenwriter making his third feature, helmed the film. It won five awards at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards in 2025, including Best Actress (Michelle Wai). At the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival's World Focus section, a 126-minute version was screened under the title 'The Last Dance'. The theatrical release is a 140-minute director's cut.

country: 日本
synopsis: 直木賞と山本周五郎賞をダブル受賞した永井紗耶子による同名小説を、柄本佑と渡辺謙の初共演で映画化したミステリー時代劇。 時は江戸時代。ある雪の降る夜、木挽町の芝居小屋「森田座」のすぐ近くで、美しい若衆・菊之助が父の仇討ちを見事に成し遂げた。その事件は多くの人々に目撃され、美談として語られることになる。1年半後、菊之助の縁者だという侍・総一郎が、仇討ちの顛末を知りたいと森田座を訪れる。菊之助に関わった人々から事件の経緯を聞くなかで徐々に事実が明らかになり、やがて仇討ちの裏に隠された「秘密」が浮かび上がる。 仇討ち事件の真相を追う田舎侍・加瀬総一郎役で柄本佑が主演を務め、森田座で謀略を巡らせる立作者・篠田金治を渡辺謙が重厚に演じる。仇討ちを成した者・伊納菊之助役で長尾謙杜（なにわ男子）、菊之助の父を手にかけ仇討ちされた無法者・作兵衛役で北村一輝、森田座の木戸芸者・一八役で瀬戸康史、森田座の立師・相良与三郎役で滝藤賢一、女形で衣裳方の芳澤ほたる役で高橋和也、小道具方の久蔵役で正名僕蔵が共演。テレビドラマ「忠臣蔵狂詩曲No.5 中村仲蔵　出世階段」などの時代劇や映画「大停電の夜に」で知られる源孝志が監督・脚本を手がけた。
synopsis_en:
A mystery period drama based on the award-winning novel by Sayako Nagai—recipient of both the Naoki Prize and the Yamamoto Shugoro Prize—marking the first screen collaboration between Tasuku Emoto and Ken Watanabe.

Set in the Edo period, the story begins on a snowy night near the Morita-za theater in Kobikicho, where a beautiful youth named Kikunosuke successfully carries out a revenge killing to avenge his father. Witnessed by many, the event is hailed as a noble tale of justice. A year and a half later, a country samurai named Soichiro Kase, claiming to be a relative of Kikunosuke, arrives at the Morita-za seeking the full story of the incident. As he interviews those connected to Kikunosuke, the facts slowly unravel, eventually exposing a "secret" hidden beneath the surface of the revenge.

Tasuku Emoto stars as Soichiro Kase, the samurai pursuing the truth, while Ken Watanabe delivers a commanding performance as Kinji Shinoda, the head playwright at Morita-za who orchestrates the schemes within the theater. The ensemble cast features Kento Nagao (Naniwa Danshi) as Kikunosuke Ino, the young man who achieved his revenge; Kazuki Kitamura as Sakubee, the outlaw who killed Kikunosuke’s father; Koji Seto as Ippachi, a theater barker; Kenichi Takito as Yosaburo Sagara, the fight choreographer; Kazuya Takahashi as Hotaru Yoshizawa, an *onnagata* actor and costume manager; and Bokuzo Masana as Kyuzo, the prop master. The film is written and directed by Takashi Minamoto, known for the period drama *Chushingura Rhapsody No. 5: Nakamura Nakazo’s Rise to Fame* and the film *Until the Lights Come Back*.

synopsis: かいせつ 「暢気眼鏡」で芥川賞を受賞した尾崎が妻をモデルにした私小説の映画化。妻を“芳兵衛”の愛称で呼ぶ食えない作家の夫(フランキー)と、素朴で愛嬌たっぷりの妻(司)との、貧しくとも幸せな日々を描いた愛すべき1本。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
synopsis_en: A film adaptation of the autobiographical novel by Ozaki, who won the Akutagawa Prize for "Norakuro Megane," with his wife as the model. This endearing film depicts the poor but happy days of a quirky writer husband (Frankie), who calls his wife by the pet name "Yoshihyoe," and his simple, charming wife (Kishi).

synopsis: かいせつ 東京から大阪に向かう特急の車内では、ウェイトレスのサヨ子(団)がコック助手の喜一(フランキー)に結婚を迫っていた―。獅子文六の人気小説の映画化で、食堂車に乗り合わせたクセ強めの乗客たちが巻き起こす騒動を描いた群像喜劇。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_jp: 東京駅発、特急こだま。食堂車ウエイトレスのサヨ子は、コック助手の喜一にプロポーズをする。サヨ子の夢は、喜一と父が昔やっていた弁当屋を大阪で開くことだった。とはいえ喜一は一流ホテルのコックなる夢を捨てられない。さらに華族出身のスチュアデス・有女子が喜一に時々ささやきかけるのが気になる。こだまが終点・大阪に着くまで6時間半。サヨ子は喜一からプロポーズの返事を受け取ることができるのか…。
tmdb_overview_en: Comedy of manners set on the "Kodama" train between Tokyo and Osaka, before the opening of the Shinkansen. In the leading role, Frankie Sakai plays a straightforward but indecisive hero. The passengers also include the bubbly Dan Reiko, and Ozawa Eitaro as a dour company president. Based on the novel "Seven and a half hours", by Shishi Bunroku.
synopsis_en: Aboard an express train from Tokyo to Osaka, waitress Sayoko (Dan) pressures kitchen assistant Kiichi (Frankie) to marry her. An adaptation of a popular novel by Bunroku Shishi, this ensemble comedy depicts the chaos stirred up by a group of eccentric passengers sharing the dining car.

synopsis: かいせつ 東北本線の車掌・吾一(フランキー)は、幼馴染の芸者・さくら（倍賞）に熱烈なアプローチを受けているが、密かに思う女性が…。喜劇の名手・瀬川がメガホンを取り、フランキー主演で全11作が製作された「旅行シリーズ」の第三作。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_jp: 旅行シリーズ第3作。鉄道会社の専務車掌・大野（フランキー堺）は、豪華寝台特急「つばめ」の運行で大忙し。思いを寄せる美女・さくら（佐藤友美）を巡り、嫉妬深い第二の女性・千枝（倍賞千恵子）とドタバタの逆転劇を繰り広げる。
tmdb_overview_en: A drama from director Masaharu Segawa.
synopsis_en: Conductor Goichi (Frankie) on the Tohoku Main Line receives passionate advances from his childhood friend, geisha Sakura (Baisho), but secretly has his eye on another woman. The third installment of the 11-film "Travel Series" starring Frankie Sakai, directed by comedy master Segawa.

movie_title: 『牛乳屋フランキー』 ＊デジタル上映
synopsis: かいせつ 親戚の牛乳店を手伝うために上京したご陽気な青年が、商売敵に負けじと奮闘する―。人気ラジオドラマの映画化で、スラップスティック・コメディの隠れた名作として知られるフランキー初期の代表作。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_en: Roppeita is big in size, clumsy and full of energy. When his grandfather orders him to move out to Tokyo to save a sinking milk delivery business a distant relative of his runs, he encounters the most strangest of clientele.
synopsis_en: A cheerful young man moves to Tokyo to help at a relative's milk shop and struggles to outdo his business rivals. A film adaptation of a popular radio drama, this is an early representative work of Frankie Sakai, known as a hidden gem of slapstick comedy.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1960年代神戸—日本で生まれたベルギー人の小さな女の子アメリ。彼女の成長を描く物語。外交官の家庭に生まれ、2歳半までは無反応状態だったアメリ。その後、子ども時代に突入した彼女は自らを「神」だと信じ、魔法のような世界を生きている。家政婦のニシオさんや家族との日々の生活は、彼女にとって冒険であり、新たな発見の連続。少しずつ変化していくアメリ。しかし、3歳の誕生日に人生を変える出来事が起こり、彼女の世界は大きく変わっていく…。誰もが子供時代に夢見た世界を描く感動のアニメーション作品
tmdb_overview_en: The world is a perplexing, peaceful mystery to Amélie until a miraculous encounter with chocolate ignites her wild sense of curiosity. As she develops a deep attachment to her family's housekeeper, Nishio-san, Amélie discovers the wonders of nature as well as the emotional truths hidden beneath the surface of her family's idyllic life as foreigners in post-war Japan.
movie_title_original: Amélie et la métaphysique des tubes
movie_title_en: Little Amélie or the Character of Rain
synopsis_en: An animated film set in 1960s Kobe, depicting the growth of Amélie, a Belgian girl born in Japan. Based on the autobiographical novel "Tube Metaphysics" by Belgian writer Amélie Nothomb, it portrays a world rich in emotion, seen through the eyes of the two-year-old protagonist Amélie, woven with life, color, and her witty words. In 1960s Kobe, Amélie, a Belgian girl born into a diplomat's family, is unresponsive until age two and a half, but then enters an invincible childhood, believing herself to be a god and living in a magical world. Her days with her beloved housekeeper Nishio and her family are adventures full of new discoveries. One day, she learns the kanji for "rain," which suits her perfectly. Then, on her third birthday, an event occurs that changes everything. Directed by Myriam Ballard and Liang-Cho Han, who worked on "Long Way North," with music by Japanese composer Mari Fukuhara. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Annecy International Animated Film Festival and was nominated for Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.

country: 香港 原題または英題：破．地獄 The Last Dance
synopsis: 「Mr.Boo！」シリーズで日本でも人気を集めた香港の喜劇王マイケル・ホイと、香港を代表するコメディアンで「毒舌弁護人　正義への戦い」など俳優としても活躍するダヨ・ウォンが32年ぶりに共演を果たし、香港映画歴代興行収入第1位を塗り替える大ヒットを記録したヒューマンドラマ。香港の葬儀業界を舞台に、「家族」「伝統」「死生観」といった普遍的なテーマを丁寧に描き出す。 ウエディングプランナーのトウサンはコロナ禍で多額の負債を抱え、やむを得ず葬儀業者に転職するが、結婚式と葬式は大きく異なり、さまざまな困難に直面してしまう。利益を追求したいトウサンに対し、ともに葬儀を取り仕切る厳格な道士・マン師匠は伝統を重んじており、2人は絶えず衝突する。しかしマン師匠やその娘マンユッと関わるうちに、マン師匠に対するトウサンのわだかまりは少しずつ消えていく。やがてトウサンは、マン師匠が葬儀で行う道教の伝統的な儀式「破地獄」の真の意味に気づきはじめる。 葬儀業者トウサンをダヨ・ウォン、マン道士をマイケル・ホイが演じた。監督は、脚本家出身で本作が長編監督第3作となるアンセルム・チャン。2025年・第43回香港電影金像奨で主演女優賞（ミシェル・ワイ）など5部門を受賞した。第37回東京国際映画祭ワールド・フォーカス部門では、「ラスト・ダンス」の邦題で126分のバージョンが上映された。劇場公開は140分のディレクターズカット版。
tmdb_overview_jp: 疫病が猛威をふるい経済が低迷するなか、葬儀社に転職したダオシェン（ダヨ・ウォン）。当初は先輩のマン（マイケル・ホイ）と衝突するダオシェンだったが、彼と仕事をするうちに人生観に変化が生まれていく。ダヨ・ウォンとマイケル・ホイ、香港映画界の二大コメディアンが『マジック・タッチ』（1992）以来32年ぶりに共演とあって、撮影時から大きな話題となっている注目作。「破地獄」とは、故人の霊を地獄から救い出すための道教の儀式を意味している。
tmdb_overview_en: Despite the pandemic sending most industries into recession, debt-ridden wedding planner Dominic (Dayo WONG) gets a miraculous chance to turn things around when a funeral planner retires and passes the baton to him. His creative gimmicks for funerals help his business find unexpected success, but Dominic’s biggest obstacle is winning the approval of respected and sternly traditional Taoist priest, Master Man (Michael HUI). After some unordinary funerals, Dominic gradually understands Master Man’s code of ethics and the meaning behind each farewell.
clean_title_jp: 旅立ちのラストダンス
synopsis_en: A human drama reuniting Hong Kong comedy king Michael Hui, popular in Japan for the 'Mr. Boo!' series, and Dayo Wong, a top Hong Kong comedian and actor ('A Witness Out of the Blue'), after 32 years. It became a massive hit, breaking Hong Kong's all-time box office record. Set in Hong Kong's funeral industry, it carefully explores universal themes of family, tradition, and views on life and death. Wedding planner To-sang, burdened with debt from the pandemic, reluctantly switches to the funeral business but faces difficulties as weddings and funerals are vastly different. To-sang, focused on profit, constantly clashes with the strict Taoist priest Master Man, who values tradition. However, as To-sang interacts with Master Man and his daughter Man-yuet, his resentment gradually fades. He begins to understand the true meaning of the traditional Taoist ritual 'Breaking Hell' that Master Man performs at funerals. Dayo Wong plays funeral director To-sang, and Michael Hui plays Taoist Master Man. Director Anselm Chan, a screenwriter making his third feature, helmed the film. It won five awards at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards in 2025, including Best Actress (Michelle Wai). At the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival's World Focus section, a 126-minute version was screened under the title 'The Last Dance'. The theatrical release is a 140-minute director's cut.

director: ラージーブ・メーナン
country: インド 原題または英題：Sarvam Thaala Mayam
synopsis: インド伝統音楽の打楽器「ムリダンガム」の奏者を目指す青年の奮闘を描いた青春音楽映画。 インドのチェンナイで暮らすムリダンガム職人の息子ピーターは、父が作ったムリダンガムを巨匠が演奏するのを見たことがきっかけで、自身もその奏者になりたいと思うように。巨匠に弟子入りし修行に励むピーターは、カースト差別や伝統芸能の継承に伴う軋轢、世代間の意見の違いなど様々な困難にぶつかりながらも、情熱と敬意をもって立ち向かっていく。 「スラムドッグ＄ミリオネア」でアカデミー作曲賞を受賞したA・R・ラフマーンが音楽を手がけ、ラフマーンの甥で映画音楽の作曲家としても知られるG・V・プラカーシュ・クマールが主人公ピーターを演じた。2018年・第31回東京国際映画祭ワールド・フォーカス部門では、「世界はリズムで満ちている」のタイトルで上映。2022年10月の劇場公開に際しては、本作にほれ込んだ南インド料理店「なんどり」（東京・荒川区）が配給した。
tmdb_overview_en: Peter who tries to find his place in the world of classical Indian music embarks on a journey that helps him evolve personally, spiritually and musically.
synopsis_en: A youth music film about a young man's struggle to become a player of the mridangam, a traditional Indian percussion instrument. Peter, the son of a mridangam craftsman living in Chennai, India, is inspired to become a player himself after seeing a master perform on a mridangam his father made. Apprenticing under the master and training diligently, Peter faces various challenges including caste discrimination, conflicts over preserving traditional arts, and generational differences, but confronts them with passion and respect. The music is composed by A. R. Rahman, who won an Academy Award for 'Slumdog Millionaire.' G. V. Prakash Kumar, Rahman's nephew and a renowned film music composer, plays the protagonist Peter. Screened under the title 'The World Is Full of Rhythms' in the World Focus section of the 31st Tokyo International Film Festival in 2018. For its theatrical release in October 2022, the film was distributed by 'Nandori,' a South Indian restaurant in Tokyo's Arakawa Ward that fell in love with the film.

synopsis: 東映動画が初めて日本や中国といった従来の舞台を離れて描いたのは、若き船乗りのロマンあふれる航海。船医の経験もあり、芥川賞受賞から間もない北杜夫と手塚治虫という異色のタッグが脚本を務めた。時に動画1枚に300もの水玉を描くほどスタッフは波の表現に尽力し、1万枚を越える作画が生み出す波は、海洋アドベンチャーならではの臨場感を湛えている。
tmdb_overview_en: Two young aspiring adventurers, Sindbad and Ali, find an old sailor who has washed up on the shore. With his final breath, the sailor tells them a tale of a hidden treasure and hands over the map he had held on to through his trials. And so, the two would-be heroes are off for adventure. But the road to riches is paved with hardships: their travels lead from stowing away on a ship to the sultan's dungeons -- only to escape with the sultan's daughter in tow!
clean_title_jp: アラビアンナイト シンドバッドの冒険
movie_title_jp: アラビアンナイト シンドバッドの冒険

movie_title_en: Arabian Nights: The Adventures of Sinbad
synopsis_en: Toei Animation's first departure from traditional Japanese or Chinese settings follows a young sailor's romantic voyage. The screenplay was an unusual collaboration between Morio Kita, a recent Akutagawa Prize winner with experience as a ship's doctor, and Osamu Tezuka. Staff went to great lengths to depict waves, sometimes painting as many as 300 polka dots on a single cel, and the resulting animation—over 10,000 drawings—imbues the ocean adventure with remarkable realism.

movie_title: 少年ジャックと魔法使い
synopsis: 東映動画の10周年作品として藪下泰次が演出、大工原章が作画監督を務めた。英雄叙事詩「ベーオウルフ」が原案だが、ジャックは自動車を乗り回し、魔女はヘリコプターで登場、魔女の城で悪魔にされた仲間を取り戻すため奮闘する。宇野誠一郎の音楽も楽しく、毎日映画コンクール音楽賞を受賞している。
tmdb_overview_en: Jack is a boy who lives with his animal friends Barnaby Bear, Dinah Dog, Squeeker Mouse and Phineas Fox. He's challenged to a race with Allegra, who turns out to be a witch. She takes Jack to the queen witch, Auriana. She plans on turning all her slaves into evil harpies.
clean_title_jp: 少年ジャックと魔法使い
movie_title_jp: 少年ジャックと魔法使い
movie_title_original: 少年ジャックと魔法使い
synopsis_en: Directed by Yasuji Yabushita with animation direction by Akira Daikuhara for Toei Animation's 10th anniversary film. Based on the heroic epic 'Beowulf,' this version features Jack driving a car, a witch arriving by helicopter, and a struggle to rescue comrades turned into demons in the witch's castle. Seiichiro Uno's cheerful music won the Mainichi Film Concours Music Award.

Based on the novel "Seven and a half hours", by Shishi Bunroku.
synopsis_en: Aboard an express train from Tokyo to Osaka, waitress Sayoko (Dan) pressures kitchen assistant Kiichi (Frankie) to marry her. An adaptation of a popular novel by Bunroku Shishi, this ensemble comedy depicts the chaos stirred up by a group of eccentric passengers sharing the dining car.

synopsis: かいせつ 東北本線の車掌・吾一(フランキー)は、幼馴染の芸者・さくら（倍賞）に熱烈なアプローチを受けているが、密かに思う女性が…。喜劇の名手・瀬川がメガホンを取り、フランキー主演で全11作が製作された「旅行シリーズ」の第三作。

synopsis_en: A cheerful young man moves to Tokyo to help at a relative's milk shop and struggles to outdo his business rivals. A film adaptation of a popular radio drama, this is an early representative work of Frankie Sakai, known as a hidden gem of slapstick comedy.

movie_title_original: Amélie et la métaphysique des tubes
movie_title_en: Little Amélie or the Character of Rain
synopsis_en: An animated film set in 1960s Kobe, depicting the growth of Amélie, a Belgian girl born in Japan. Based on the autobiographical novel "Tube Metaphysics" by Belgian writer Amélie Nothomb, it portrays a world rich in emotion, seen through the eyes of the two-year-old protagonist Amélie, woven with life, color, and her witty words. In 1960s Kobe, Amélie, a Belgian girl born into a diplomat's family, is unresponsive until age two and a half, but then enters an invincible childhood, believing herself to be a god and living in a magical world. Her days with her beloved housekeeper Nishio and her family are adventures full of new discoveries. One day, she learns the kanji for "rain," which suits her perfectly. Then, on her third birthday, an event occurs that changes everything. Directed by Myriam Ballard and Liang-Cho Han, who worked on "Long Way North," with music by Japanese composer Mari Fukuhara. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Annecy International Animated Film Festival and was nominated for Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.

synopsis: 「Mr.Boo！」シリーズで日本でも人気を集めた香港の喜劇王マイケル・ホイと、香港を代表するコメディアンで「毒舌弁護人　正義への戦い」など俳優としても活躍するダヨ・ウォンが32年ぶりに共演を果たし、香港映画歴代興行収入第1位を塗り替える大ヒットを記録したヒューマンドラマ。香港の葬儀業界を舞台に、「家族」「伝統」「死生観」といった普遍的なテーマを丁寧に描き出す。 ウエディングプランナーのトウサンはコロナ禍で多額の負債を抱え、やむを得ず葬儀業者に転職するが、結婚式と葬式は大きく異なり、さまざまな困難に直面してしまう。利益を追求したいトウサンに対し、ともに葬儀を取り仕切る厳格な道士・マン師匠は伝統を重んじており、2人は絶えず衝突する。しかしマン師匠やその娘マンユッと関わるうちに、マン師匠に対するトウサンのわだかまりは少しずつ消えていく。やがてトウサンは、マン師匠が葬儀で行う道教の伝統的な儀式「破地獄」の真の意味に気づきはじめる。 葬儀業者トウサンをダヨ・ウォン、マン道士をマイケル・ホイが演じた。監督は、脚本家出身で本作が長編監督第3作となるアンセルム・チャン。2025年・第43回香港電影金像奨で主演女優賞（ミシェル・ワイ）など5部門を受賞した。第37回東京国際映画祭ワールド・フォーカス部門では、「ラスト・ダンス」の邦題で126分のバージョンが上映された。劇場公開は140分のディレクターズカット版。
tmdb_overview_jp: 疫病が猛威をふるい経済が低迷するなか、葬儀社に転職したダオシェン（ダヨ・ウォン）。当初は先輩のマン（マイケル・ホイ）と衝突するダオシェンだったが、彼と仕事をするうちに人生観に変化が生まれていく。ダヨ・ウォンとマイケル・ホイ、香港映画界の二大コメディアンが『マジック・タッチ』（1992）以来32年ぶりに共演とあって、撮影時から大きな話題となっている注目作。「破地獄」とは、故人の霊を地獄から救い出すための道教の儀式を意味している。
tmdb_overview_en: Despite the pandemic sending most industries into recession, debt-ridden wedding planner Dominic (Dayo WONG) gets a miraculous chance to turn things around when a funeral planner retires and passes the baton to him. His creative gimmicks for funerals help his business find unexpected success, but Dominic’s biggest obstacle is winning the approval of respected and sternly traditional Taoist priest, Master Man (Michael HUI). After some unordinary funerals, Dominic gradually understands Master Man’s code of ethics and the meaning behind each farewell.
clean_title_jp: 旅立ちのラストダンス
synopsis_en: A human drama reuniting Hong Kong comedy king Michael Hui, popular in Japan for the 'Mr. Boo!' series, and Dayo Wong, a top Hong Kong comedian and actor ('A Witness Out of the Blue'), after 32 years. It became a massive hit, breaking Hong Kong's all-time box office record. Set in Hong Kong's funeral industry, it carefully explores universal themes of family, tradition, and views on life and death. Wedding planner To-sang, burdened with debt from the pandemic, reluctantly switches to the funeral business but faces difficulties as weddings and funerals are vastly different. To-sang, focused on profit, constantly clashes with the strict Taoist priest Master Man, who values tradition. However, as To-sang interacts with Master Man and his daughter Man-yuet, his resentment gradually fades. He begins to understand the true meaning of the traditional Taoist ritual 'Breaking Hell' that Master Man performs at funerals. Dayo Wong plays funeral director To-sang, and Michael Hui plays Taoist Master Man. Director Anselm Chan, a screenwriter making his third feature, helmed the film. It won five awards at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards in 2025, including Best Actress (Michelle Wai). At the 37th Tokyo International Film Festival's World Focus section, a 126-minute version was screened under the title 'The Last Dance'. The theatrical release is a 140-minute director's cut.

synopsis: インド伝統音楽の打楽器「ムリダンガム」の奏者を目指す青年の奮闘を描いた青春音楽映画。 インドのチェンナイで暮らすムリダンガム職人の息子ピーターは、父が作ったムリダンガムを巨匠が演奏するのを見たことがきっかけで、自身もその奏者になりたいと思うように。巨匠に弟子入りし修行に励むピーターは、カースト差別や伝統芸能の継承に伴う軋轢、世代間の意見の違いなど様々な困難にぶつかりながらも、情熱と敬意をもって立ち向かっていく。 「スラムドッグ＄ミリオネア」でアカデミー作曲賞を受賞したA・R・ラフマーンが音楽を手がけ、ラフマーンの甥で映画音楽の作曲家としても知られるG・V・プラカーシュ・クマールが主人公ピーターを演じた。2018年・第31回東京国際映画祭ワールド・フォーカス部門では、「世界はリズムで満ちている」のタイトルで上映。2022年10月の劇場公開に際しては、本作にほれ込んだ南インド料理店「なんどり」（東京・荒川区）が配給した。
tmdb_overview_en: Peter who tries to find his place in the world of classical Indian music embarks on a journey that helps him evolve personally, spiritually and musically.
synopsis_en: A youth music film about a young man's struggle to become a player of the mridangam, a traditional Indian percussion instrument. Peter, the son of a mridangam craftsman living in Chennai, India, is inspired to become a player himself after seeing a master perform on a mridangam his father made. Apprenticing under the master and training diligently, Peter faces various challenges including caste discrimination, conflicts over preserving traditional arts, and generational differences, but confronts them with passion and respect. The music is composed by A. R. Rahman, who won an Academy Award for 'Slumdog Millionaire.' G. V. Prakash Kumar, Rahman's nephew and a renowned film music composer, plays the protagonist Peter. Screened under the title 'The World Is Full of Rhythms' in the World Focus section of the 31st Tokyo International Film Festival in 2018. For its theatrical release in October 2022, the film was distributed by 'Nandori,' a South Indian restaurant in Tokyo's Arakawa Ward that fell in love with the film.

synopsis_en: Elementary school student Kōichi Uehara finds a large stone buried on a riverbank on his way home. Driven by curiosity, he cracks it open and discovers a dried-up, fossil-like creature inside. It is a baby kappa that has been in a state of suspended animation underground for a long time. Kōichi names it 'Kū' and begins living with it.

tmdb_overview_en: When Yumiko Tsuyama, a potter by profession, comes inquiring about a room for rent in an old mansion overlooking Osaka, she finds a bizarre collection of characters already living there. The unlikely leader of this menagerie is Yoda Goro, who speaks four languages fluently, is an expert in cabbage rolls, and has written  how-to books encompassing every aspect of human existence.
synopsis_en: In a large rundown house overlooking the Tsutenkaku Tower in Osaka, a group of eccentric lodgers live... Frankie, in his famous partnership with Kawashima, plays a laid-back jack-of-all-trades who works as a ghostwriter and konnyaku maker. With unique supporting actors like Naniwa and Ozawa, this is a brilliant ensemble comedy that leaves a lasting impression.

Riding the unprecedented manga boom, this film features Frankie as a manga artist and is a legendary oddity, with appearances by 'Obake no Q-taro' and 'Osomatsu-kun' within the story.

A heartwarming comedy woven by a man who, even 25 years after the war, still carries the scars of burnt ruins and black markets in his heart. Frankie gives a poignant performance as a man working hard as a street performer and at a host club.

synopsis: インドに暮らすムスリム女性たちの100日以上にわたる平和的な抵抗運動を追ったドキュメンタリー。 2019年12月、インドのモディ政権はイスラム教徒を意図的に排除する市民権改正法を制定し、イスラム教徒の間では市民権を剥奪される危機感が高まった。法案に対する批判の声が高まるなか、反対運動の拠点であるジャミア・ミリア・イスラミア大学構内に警察が突入し、200人もの負傷者と多数の逮捕者を出した。この暴力的な対応と差別的な法案への抗議として、ニューデリー南部のイスラム教徒居住区シャヒーン・バーグで大規模な座り込みが始まる。その中心にいたのはムスリムの女性たちで、政府による宗教差別やデモ鎮圧は憲法違反だと主張し、日々の暮らしを営みながら100日以上にわたり幹線道路を封鎖した。この非暴力の運動は多くの人々の共感を呼び、世代や文化、宗教を越えてインド全土に広まった。しかしデリー議会選挙をきっかけに状況は緊迫し、警察による強制排除が起こる。 ムスリム女性のノウシーン・ハーンが監督を務め、政治的にも社会的にも透明化されてきたムスリム女性たちによる歴史的抵抗運動の軌跡に、自らの解放と変革の物語を重ねながら描き出す。山形国際ドキュメンタリー映画祭2023にて市民賞（観客賞）を受賞（映画祭上映時タイトル「我が理想の国」）。
synopsis_en: A documentary following over 100 days of peaceful resistance by Muslim women living in India. In December 2019, India's Modi government enacted the Citizenship Amendment Act, which deliberately excludes Muslims, heightening fears among Muslims of losing their citizenship. As criticism of the bill grew, police stormed the campus of Jamia Millia Islamia University, a protest hub, injuring 200 people and making numerous arrests. In protest against this violent response and the discriminatory law, a massive sit-in began in Shaheen Bagh, a Muslim neighborhood in South Delhi. At its center were Muslim women who, arguing that the government's religious discrimination and crackdown on protests were unconstitutional, blocked a major highway for over 100 days while continuing their daily lives. This nonviolent movement resonated with many, spreading across India beyond generations, cultures, and religions. However, tensions escalated around the Delhi legislative elections, leading to a forced police eviction. Directed by Muslim woman Nousheen Khan, the film traces the historical resistance movement by Muslim women, who have been politically and socially rendered invisible, while overlaying her own story of liberation and transformation. It won the Audience Award at the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2023 (screened under the title 'My Ideal Country').

tmdb_overview_en: The world is a perplexing, peaceful mystery to Amélie until a miraculous encounter with chocolate ignites her wild sense of curiosity. As she develops a deep attachment to her family's housekeeper, Nishio-san, Amélie discovers the wonders of nature as well as the emotional truths hidden beneath the surface of her family's idyllic life as foreigners in post-war Japan.
movie_title_original: Amélie et la métaphysique des tubes
movie_title_en: Little Amélie or the Character of Rain
synopsis_en: An animated film set in 1960s Kobe, depicting the growth of Amélie, a Belgian girl born in Japan. Based on the autobiographical novel "Tube Metaphysics" by Belgian writer Amélie Nothomb, it portrays a world rich in emotion, seen through the eyes of the two-year-old protagonist Amélie, woven with life, color, and her witty words. In 1960s Kobe, Amélie, a Belgian girl born into a diplomat's family, is unresponsive until age two and a half, but then enters an invincible childhood, believing herself to be a god and living in a magical world. Her days with her beloved housekeeper Nishio and her family are adventures full of new discoveries. One day, she learns the kanji for "rain," which suits her perfectly. Then, on her third birthday, an event occurs that changes everything. Directed by Myriam Ballard and Liang-Cho Han, who worked on "Long Way North," with music by Japanese composer Mari Fukuhara. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Annecy International Animated Film Festival and was nominated for Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.

country: インド 原題または英題：Kandukondain Kandukondain
synopsis: イギリスの女性作家ジェーン・オースティンが1811年に発表した小説「分別と多感」を、舞台を現代の南インドに移して映画化した恋愛ドラマ。「響け！情熱のムリダンガム」の監督ラージーブ・メーナンと音楽のA・R・ラフマーンのコンビが2000年に手がけた。 南インド・タミルナードゥ州の由緒ある名家。慎ましく聡明な姉ソウミャは学校の校長を務め、詩と南インド古典音楽を愛する奔放な妹ミーナクシは夢見るように日々を過ごしていた。しかし祖父の死をきっかけに屋敷は遠縁の手に渡り、母と娘たちは大都会チェンナイで新たな生活を始めることになる。妹の前には詩を愛する若き実業家と、内戦で片足を失い花を育てて生きる元軍人が現れ、姉の前には映画監督を志す男が現れる。それぞれの恋と仕事のなかで、姉妹は自分の人生を一つずつ見つけていく。 姉ソウミャを「その名にちなんで」「ライフ・オブ・パイ　トラと漂流した227日」で知られるタブー、妹ミーナクシを「ロボット」のアイシュワリヤー・ラーイ・バッチャンが演じ、アジット・クマール、マンムーティ、アッバースが共演。
synopsis_en: A romantic drama adapting Jane Austen's 1811 novel 'Sense and Sensibility,' relocated to modern-day South India. Directed by Rajiv Menon and featuring music by A. R. Rahman, the duo behind 'Mridangam: The Beat of Passion,' this film was released in 2000. In a prestigious family in Tamil Nadu, South India, the reserved and intelligent elder sister Sowmya works as a school principal, while her free-spirited younger sister Meenakshi, who loves poetry and South Indian classical music, lives in a dreamy haze. After their grandfather's death, the family estate passes to a distant relative, forcing the mother and daughters to start a new life in the bustling city of Chennai. Meenakshi meets a young businessman who loves poetry and a former soldier who lost a leg in war and now grows flowers, while Sowmya encounters a man aspiring to be a film director. Through their respective loves and careers, the sisters gradually discover their own paths in life. Tabu, known for 'The Namesake' and 'Life of Pi,' plays Sowmya; Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, known for 'Robot,' plays Meenakshi; and Ajith Kumar, Mammootty, and Abbas co-star.

synopsis: 王となったアリババの末裔アリババ33世は享楽にふけり、ランプの魔物を使って国民を苦しめた。盗賊の末裔アル・ハックと１匹のネズミ、38匹の猫は協力し、空飛ぶじゅうたんで城に乗り込む。丸くデフォルメされたキャラクターに大工原章の挑戦が見られる。ハック少年は大山のぶ代が演じ、回想の影絵シーンは劇団かかし座が担当した。この年に東映社長の大川博は急逝し、製作としてクレジットされた最後の作品となった。
tmdb_overview_jp: アリババ33世。初代アリババが手に入れた莫大な財宝も、32世までで半分を、そして33世があとの半分を使い切って、もはや残るのは古ぼけたランプがただ一つ。実はこれがこすると魔物が出てきて何でもするというランプなのだ。しかしランプの魔物、猫がいるとまるでダメ。そこで徹底的な猫狩りが行われる。そんな時、捕らえられた猫を助けたのがアル・ハック。彼は猫の英雄として38匹の猫と共に反抗に立ち上がった。
tmdb_overview_en: A peasant boy and 38 cats band against the tyrannical Ali Baba the 33rd and his cat-phobic genie.
movie_title_en: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves
synopsis_en: Alibaba XXXIII, descendant of the original Alibaba and now king, indulges in pleasure and uses the lamp's genie to oppress his people. The descendant of a thief, Al-Hack, teams up with one mouse and 38 cats, riding a flying carpet into the castle. Akira Daikuhara's challenge is evident in the round, deformed characters. Hack is voiced by Nobuyo Oyama, and the shadow-puppet flashback scenes were handled by the theater troupe Kakashiza. This was the last film credited to Toei president Hiroshi Okawa, who passed away suddenly that year.

movie_title: ちびっ子レミと名犬カピ
synopsis: 原作は「家なき子」。継父に旅芸人へと売られても、少年レミはくじけない。背景美術にはミレーやモネなど多様なヨーロッパの名画の要素を取り入れ、芹川有吾による絶妙な「溜め」の演出が苦難の旅路を劇的に盛り上げる。フランキー堺が声を演じる相棒カピのおどけた佇まいが、悲劇のつるべ打ちに一服の清涼剤を与えている。
tmdb_overview_en: Japanese animation adaptation of a 19th century French novel: A boy is given up by his foster parents to a traveling performer.
clean_title_jp: ちびっ子レミと名犬カピ
movie_title_jp: ちびっ子レミと名犬カピ
movie_title_original: ちびっ子レミと名犬カピ
movie_title_en: Little Remi and Famous Dog Capi
synopsis_en: Based on 'Nobody's Boy.' Even after being sold by his stepfather to traveling performers, young Remi never loses heart. The background art incorporates elements from diverse European masterpieces by Millet and Monet, while Yugo Serikawa's masterful use of dramatic pauses heightens the arduous journey. Frankie Sakai's voice performance as Remi's sidekick Capi, with his playful demeanor, offers a refreshing respite amid the relentless tragedy.

synopsis: かいせつ 大阪の通天閣を望む広いボロ屋敷には風変りな間借り人たちがいた…。川島との名コンビのフランキーが、代筆やこんにゃく製造などに精を出すなんでも屋を飄々と演じ、浪花、小沢ら個性的な脇役陣もクセになる傑作群像喜劇。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_en: When Yumiko Tsuyama, a potter by profession, comes inquiring about a room for rent in an old mansion overlooking Osaka, she finds a bizarre collection of characters already living there. The unlikely leader of this menagerie is Yoda Goro, who speaks four languages fluently, is an expert in cabbage rolls, and has written  how-to books encompassing every aspect of human existence.
synopsis_en: In a large rundown house overlooking the Tsutenkaku Tower in Osaka, a group of eccentric lodgers live... Frankie, in his famous partnership with Kawashima, plays a laid-back jack-of-all-trades who works as a ghostwriter and konnyaku maker. With unique supporting actors like Naniwa and Ozawa, this is a brilliant ensemble comedy that leaves a lasting impression.

movie_title_en: A Comedy in Front of the Station: Manga
synopsis: かいせつ フランキー、森繁、伴淳の主演で全24作も製作された「駅前シリーズ」の第15作。空前の漫画ブームに乗り、フランキーが漫画家に扮した本作は、劇中で「オバケのQ太郎」「おそ松くん」も登場する伝説の異色作となっている。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_en: 15th entry in the Ekimae series, surrounding the then-insanely popular Weekly Shounen Sunday series Osomatsu-kun and Obake no Q-Taro.
synopsis_en: The 15th installment of the 'Ekimaé Series,' which produced 24 films starring Frankie, Morishige, and Bando. Riding the unprecedented manga boom, this film features Frankie as a manga artist and is a legendary oddity, with appearances by 'Obake no Q-taro' and 'Osomatsu-kun' within the story.

synopsis: かいせつ 元戦災孤児の男は、自分を拾ってくれた娼婦の忘れ形見の少年と暮らしていた…。戦後25年を過ぎても焼け跡と闇市を心に刻み続ける男が織りなす人情喜劇。フランキーは、チンドン屋とホストクラブで懸命に働く男を切なく好演。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
synopsis_en: A former war orphan lives with the child of the prostitute who took him in... A heartwarming comedy woven by a man who, even 25 years after the war, still carries the scars of burnt ruins and black markets in his heart. Frankie gives a poignant performance as a man working hard as a street performer and at a host club.

movie_title: 『倖せは俺等のねがい』 ＊デジタル上映
synopsis: かいせつ 念願の新居に引っ越した結婚目前の工場勤めの二人が、遠縁の四人の子供を押しつけられて…。庶民のささやかな幸せをみつめた名優・宇野の監督第三作。フランキーは本作と『幕末太陽傳』でブルーリボン主演男優賞を受賞。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
synopsis_en: A couple working at a factory, on the verge of marriage and moving into their long-awaited new home, are saddled with four distant relatives' children... The third directorial work by the renowned actor Uno, who captures the modest happiness of ordinary people. Frankie won the Blue Ribbon Award for Best Actor for this film and 'The Sun of the Meiji Restoration'.

synopsis_en: A romantic drama adapting Jane Austen's 1811 novel 'Sense and Sensibility,' relocated to modern-day South India. Directed by Rajiv Menon and featuring music by A. R. Rahman, the duo behind 'Mridangam: The Beat of Passion,' this film was released in 2000. In a prestigious family in Tamil Nadu, South India, the reserved and intelligent elder sister Sowmya works as a school principal, while her free-spirited younger sister Meenakshi, who loves poetry and South Indian classical music, lives in a dreamy haze. After their grandfather's death, the family estate passes to a distant relative, forcing the mother and daughters to start a new life in the bustling city of Chennai. Meenakshi meets a young businessman who loves poetry and a former soldier who lost a leg in war and now grows flowers, while Sowmya encounters a man aspiring to be a film director. Through their respective loves and careers, the sisters gradually discover their own paths in life. Tabu, known for 'The Namesake' and 'Life of Pi,' plays Sowmya; Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, known for 'Robot,' plays Meenakshi; and Ajith Kumar, Mammootty, and Abbas co-star.

synopsis: 子犬のロックが、母の仇である虎のキラーを倒すため野良犬たちと立ち上がる。「忠臣蔵」と巌谷小波の児童文学「こがね丸」を下敷きにしながら、それまでの長篇群に比して明確にディズニーのスタイルが意識されている。無国籍的な都会描写や、手塚治虫のアイデアによる雪の降りしきる遊園地でのアクションには、洒脱でモダンな感覚が息づいている。
tmdb_overview_jp: 森の動物たちを守る母犬シロは虎のキラーに恨みを買ってしまう。キラーの手下のキツネのアカミミにおびき出されたシロは、虎のキラーに崖から突き落とされ、命を落としてしまう。シロの子ロックは復讐を誓い、キラーとアカミミを倒しに行くが、子犬のロックではとてもかなわなかった。森の動物たちに救われたロックは町に出て野良犬たちと出会う。町の野良犬たちの中で、虎に単身闘いを挑んだロックは人望を集めるが、アカミミの策略で倉庫荒らしに仕立て上げられ、樽の中に入れられ海に捨てられてしまう。やがて時がたち、森の動物たちは人間につかまって動物園に連れていかれてしまう。森の動物たちがいなくなり獲物がなくなったキラーはアカミミの進言により自ら動物園に入り、そこでも森の動物たちを虐げる。かたや海に捨てられたロックは流れ着いた島の少女に命を救われ、成犬に成長していた。ツバメから森の動物たちの状況を聞いたロックは島を抜け出し町に戻り、かつての仲間、野良犬たちと再会する。宿敵キラーを倒す為、ロックは雪の寒い日、町中の野良犬たちを引き連れて動物園に向かう。ローラーコースターの上でロックとキラーの最後の戦いが繰り広げられる。
tmdb_overview_en: It tells the story of Rock, a puppy whose mother is killed by a tiger and a fox. To fulfill his revenge, will achieve together a large number of animals. An animated collaboration between Osamu Tezuka and Toei Animation.
synopsis_en: A puppy named Rock rises up with stray dogs to defeat Killer the tiger, who killed his mother. Drawing on 'Chushingura' and Sazanami Iwaya's children's literature 'Koganemaru,' this film more consciously adopts Disney's style compared to earlier feature-length works. The stateless urban depictions and the action in a snow-covered amusement park, inspired by an idea from Osamu Tezuka, exude a chic and modern sensibility.

synopsis: 東映動画初のSF長篇。黒田昌郎が単独で演出した最初の長篇でもあり、デザイン性の高い画面構成やミュージカル調の作風が、寓話性を帯びた世界観を際立たせる。メタ映画的な構造を取り入れる野心的な試みもなされ、東映動画における新世代の躍進を思わせる一作となった。ラストに明かされる王女の秘密には文明批判の意図が滲むが、これは動画スタッフだった宮崎駿の発案による。
tmdb_overview_jp: 両親も住む家もない、貧しいが多くの夢を持つ少年のテッド。ある日科学者のガリバー博士と出会った彼は、博士と一緒にロケット「ガリバー号」に乗って宇宙探索へ行くことに!?希望の星を目指して旅する2人だったが、やっとたどりついた星には希望がなく…。
tmdb_overview_en: The story concerns a homeless boy named Ted. After seeing a movie about Gulliver he meets Professor Gulliver himself in a forest. Gulliver is now an elderly, space-traveling scientist. With Dr. Gulliver's assistant Crow, and Ted's companions, a talking dog and a toy soldier, they travel the Milky Way to the Planet of Blue Hope, which has been taken over by the Queen of Purple Planet and her evil group of robots. Armed with water-pistols and water balloons, which melt the villains, Ricky and Gulliver restore Blue Hope to its doll-like owners.

synopsis_en: Toei Animation's first sci-fi feature. It is also the first feature-length film solely directed by Kuroda Yoshiro, whose highly designed compositions and musical style highlight the allegorical world. Ambitious meta-cinematic structures are employed, marking a breakthrough for a new generation at Toei Animation. The princess's secret revealed at the end carries a critique of civilization, an idea proposed by then-animator Hayao Miyazaki.

synopsis_en: In a large rundown house overlooking the Tsutenkaku Tower in Osaka, a group of eccentric lodgers live... Frankie, in his famous partnership with Kawashima, plays a laid-back jack-of-all-trades who works as a ghostwriter and konnyaku maker. With unique supporting actors like Naniwa and Ozawa, this is a brilliant ensemble comedy that leaves a lasting impression.

movie_title: わたしの聖なるインド
movie_title_jp: わたしの聖なるインド
country: インド 原題または英題：Land of My Dreams
synopsis: インドに暮らすムスリム女性たちの100日以上にわたる平和的な抵抗運動を追ったドキュメンタリー。 2019年12月、インドのモディ政権はイスラム教徒を意図的に排除する市民権改正法を制定し、イスラム教徒の間では市民権を剥奪される危機感が高まった。法案に対する批判の声が高まるなか、反対運動の拠点であるジャミア・ミリア・イスラミア大学構内に警察が突入し、200人もの負傷者と多数の逮捕者を出した。この暴力的な対応と差別的な法案への抗議として、ニューデリー南部のイスラム教徒居住区シャヒーン・バーグで大規模な座り込みが始まる。その中心にいたのはムスリムの女性たちで、政府による宗教差別やデモ鎮圧は憲法違反だと主張し、日々の暮らしを営みながら100日以上にわたり幹線道路を封鎖した。この非暴力の運動は多くの人々の共感を呼び、世代や文化、宗教を越えてインド全土に広まった。しかしデリー議会選挙をきっかけに状況は緊迫し、警察による強制排除が起こる。 ムスリム女性のノウシーン・ハーンが監督を務め、政治的にも社会的にも透明化されてきたムスリム女性たちによる歴史的抵抗運動の軌跡に、自らの解放と変革の物語を重ねながら描き出す。山形国際ドキュメンタリー映画祭2023にて市民賞（観客賞）を受賞（映画祭上映時タイトル「我が理想の国」）。
synopsis_en: A documentary following over 100 days of peaceful resistance by Muslim women living in India. In December 2019, India's Modi government enacted the Citizenship Amendment Act, which deliberately excludes Muslims, heightening fears among Muslims of losing their citizenship. As criticism of the bill grew, police stormed the campus of Jamia Millia Islamia University, a protest hub, injuring 200 people and making numerous arrests. In protest against this violent response and the discriminatory law, a massive sit-in began in Shaheen Bagh, a Muslim neighborhood in South Delhi. At its center were Muslim women who, arguing that the government's religious discrimination and crackdown on protests were unconstitutional, blocked a major highway for over 100 days while continuing their daily lives. This nonviolent movement resonated with many, spreading across India beyond generations, cultures, and religions. However, tensions escalated around the Delhi legislative elections, leading to a forced police eviction. Directed by Muslim woman Nousheen Khan, the film traces the historical resistance movement by Muslim women, who have been politically and socially rendered invisible, while overlaying her own story of liberation and transformation. It won the Audience Award at the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2023 (screened under the title 'My Ideal Country').

synopsis: インドに暮らすムスリム女性たちの100日以上にわたる平和的な抵抗運動を追ったドキュメンタリー。 2019年12月、インドのモディ政権はイスラム教徒を意図的に排除する市民権改正法を制定し、イスラム教徒の間では市民権を剥奪される危機感が高まった。法案に対する批判の声が高まるなか、反対運動の拠点であるジャミア・ミリア・イスラミア大学構内に警察が突入し、200人もの負傷者と多数の逮捕者を出した。この暴力的な対応と差別的な法案への抗議として、ニューデリー南部のイスラム教徒居住区シャヒーン・バーグで大規模な座り込みが始まる。その中心にいたのはムスリムの女性たちで、政府による宗教差別やデモ鎮圧は憲法違反だと主張し、日々の暮らしを営みながら100日以上にわたり幹線道路を封鎖した。この非暴力の運動は多くの人々の共感を呼び、世代や文化、宗教を越えてインド全土に広まった。しかしデリー議会選挙をきっかけに状況は緊迫し、警察による強制排除が起こる。 ムスリム女性のノウシーン・ハーンが監督を務め、政治的にも社会的にも透明化されてきたムスリム女性たちによる歴史的抵抗運動の軌跡に、自らの解放と変革の物語を重ねながら描き出す。山形国際ドキュメンタリー映画祭2023にて市民賞（観客賞）を受賞（映画祭上映時タイトル「我が理想の国」）。
synopsis_en: A documentary following over 100 days of peaceful resistance by Muslim women living in India. In December 2019, India's Modi government enacted the Citizenship Amendment Act, which deliberately excludes Muslims, heightening fears among Muslims of losing their citizenship. As criticism of the bill grew, police stormed the campus of Jamia Millia Islamia University, a protest hub, injuring 200 people and making numerous arrests. In protest against this violent response and the discriminatory law, a massive sit-in began in Shaheen Bagh, a Muslim neighborhood in South Delhi. At its center were Muslim women who, arguing that the government's religious discrimination and crackdown on protests were unconstitutional, blocked a major highway for over 100 days while continuing their daily lives. This nonviolent movement resonated with many, spreading across India beyond generations, cultures, and religions. However, tensions escalated around the Delhi legislative elections, leading to a forced police eviction. Directed by Muslim woman Nousheen Khan, the film traces the historical resistance movement by Muslim women, who have been politically and socially rendered invisible, while overlaying her own story of liberation and transformation. It won the Audience Award at the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2023 (screened under the title 'My Ideal Country').

synopsis_en: An animated film set in 1960s Kobe, depicting the growth of Amélie, a Belgian girl born in Japan. Based on the autobiographical novel "Tube Metaphysics" by Belgian writer Amélie Nothomb, it portrays a world rich in emotion, seen through the eyes of the two-year-old protagonist Amélie, woven with life, color, and her witty words. In 1960s Kobe, Amélie, a Belgian girl born into a diplomat's family, is unresponsive until age two and a half, but then enters an invincible childhood, believing herself to be a god and living in a magical world. Her days with her beloved housekeeper Nishio and her family are adventures full of new discoveries. One day, she learns the kanji for "rain," which suits her perfectly. Then, on her third birthday, an event occurs that changes everything. Directed by Myriam Ballard and Liang-Cho Han, who worked on "Long Way North," with music by Japanese composer Mari Fukuhara. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Annecy International Animated Film Festival and was nominated for Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.

synopsis: イギリスの女性作家ジェーン・オースティンが1811年に発表した小説「分別と多感」を、舞台を現代の南インドに移して映画化した恋愛ドラマ。「響け！情熱のムリダンガム」の監督ラージーブ・メーナンと音楽のA・R・ラフマーンのコンビが2000年に手がけた。 南インド・タミルナードゥ州の由緒ある名家。慎ましく聡明な姉ソウミャは学校の校長を務め、詩と南インド古典音楽を愛する奔放な妹ミーナクシは夢見るように日々を過ごしていた。しかし祖父の死をきっかけに屋敷は遠縁の手に渡り、母と娘たちは大都会チェンナイで新たな生活を始めることになる。妹の前には詩を愛する若き実業家と、内戦で片足を失い花を育てて生きる元軍人が現れ、姉の前には映画監督を志す男が現れる。それぞれの恋と仕事のなかで、姉妹は自分の人生を一つずつ見つけていく。 姉ソウミャを「その名にちなんで」「ライフ・オブ・パイ　トラと漂流した227日」で知られるタブー、妹ミーナクシを「ロボット」のアイシュワリヤー・ラーイ・バッチャンが演じ、アジット・クマール、マンムーティ、アッバースが共演。
synopsis_en: A romantic drama adapting Jane Austen's 1811 novel 'Sense and Sensibility,' relocated to modern-day South India. Directed by Rajiv Menon and featuring music by A. R. Rahman, the duo behind 'Mridangam: The Beat of Passion,' this film was released in 2000. In a prestigious family in Tamil Nadu, South India, the reserved and intelligent elder sister Sowmya works as a school principal, while her free-spirited younger sister Meenakshi, who loves poetry and South Indian classical music, lives in a dreamy haze. After their grandfather's death, the family estate passes to a distant relative, forcing the mother and daughters to start a new life in the bustling city of Chennai. Meenakshi meets a young businessman who loves poetry and a former soldier who lost a leg in war and now grows flowers, while Sowmya encounters a man aspiring to be a film director. Through their respective loves and careers, the sisters gradually discover their own paths in life. Tabu, known for 'The Namesake' and 'Life of Pi,' plays Sowmya; Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, known for 'Robot,' plays Meenakshi; and Ajith Kumar, Mammootty, and Abbas co-star.

synopsis: 草創期のTVアニメは受注が不安定だったことから、劇場用を安定受注するため企画された中篇映画「B作」の1作目（従来の長篇は「A作」と呼ばれる）。石ノ森章太郎（当時・石森章太郎）の人気SFマンガを原作にとり、作画監督に「レインボー戦隊ロビン」の木村圭市郎ほかTVアニメのスタッフを起用、TVの省力化技法も使われた。仲間の1人を子供の姿にするなど原作からの変更もあるが、戦いは陸、海、空へと展開して娯楽性は高く、スコープサイズを意識した画作りも見られる。
tmdb_overview_jp: 世界各地の都市を破壊する巨大怪獣を倒すべく、平和な日常を捨てて、再び集結したサイボーグ戦士たち。その旅の途中で009は記憶喪失の少女・ヘレナと出会うが、それさえも「黒い幽霊団（ブラック・ゴースト）」の罠だった。怪獣を追い詰めたその先に待っていたのは009の前に立ちはだかるヘレナ。なんと彼女は「黒い幽霊団（ブラック・ゴースト）」のスパイ、サイボーグ0010だったのだ！ ヘレナと対決するものの、彼女にトドメを刺すことができない009。やがて009に命を救われたことで心が動いたヘレナの助力によって、サイボーグ戦士たちは敵基地の爆破に成功し、ついには「黒い幽霊団（ブラック・ゴースト）」の野望を打ち砕いたのであった。
tmdb_overview_en: Cyborg 009 and his team are re-united to fight the latest menace from the Black Ghost. Before they can tackle their foe the team must overcome an army of monsters sent to stop them, including giant jellyfish, stingrays, plesiosaurs and treacherous cyborgs.

synopsis_en: During the early days of TV anime, orders were unstable, so to secure steady theatrical commissions, a medium-length film series called "B Works" was planned (conventional feature-length films were called "A Works"). Based on Shotaro Ishinomori's popular sci-fi manga, the film employed TV anime staff such as Keiichiro Kimura, the animation director of "Rainbow Sentai Robin," and utilized TV production efficiency techniques. While there were changes from the original manga, such as turning one of the characters into a child, the battles unfold across land, sea, and air, offering high entertainment value, and the composition shows awareness of widescreen framing.

movie_title: マジンガーZ 対 暗黒大将軍
synopsis: 乗り込み型巨大ロボットを主役としたTVアニメ「マジンガーZ」の劇場版。監督の西沢信孝は主人公の悩みや痛みをロボットに託してドラマを盛り上げ、無敵のマジンガーZがボロボロになって戦う姿を描いている。TVに先駆けて後継のグレートマジンガーが登場したことも子供たちを驚かせた。「マジンガーZ」は玩具などの版権収入が好調で、以後、企画時からマーチャンダイズを織り込んだ作品が広がるきっかけとなった。
tmdb_overview_jp: ある日、世界各国の主要都市を謎の巨大ロボット群が襲撃する。それは、ミケーネ帝国の暗黒大将軍によって送り込まれた戦闘獣軍団の先発隊だった。  ニューヨーク、ロンドン、パリ、モスクワを壊滅させたその魔の手は、日本にも伸びていた。東京への襲撃に際し、兜甲児はマジンガーZで出動するが、新たな敵・戦闘獣の攻撃力は機械獣を凌駕しており、大苦戦を強いられる。何とか敵を退けて首都の壊滅は食い止めたものの、マジンガーZが大ダメージを受けたうえに光子力研究所も襲撃されてダイアナンAは大破し、兜シローが生死をさまよう重傷を負ってしまう。シローへの大量輸血による最悪の体調の甲児と、修理できないまま再出撃したマジンガーZの前に、獣魔将軍率いる戦闘獣軍団が迫る。  死を覚悟した甲児の必死の防戦もむなしく、たちまち満身創痍と化したマジンガーZの窮地に、新たなる勇者グレートマジンガーが颯爽と現れる。

Its up to Kouji and his Mazinger Z to stand up to this threat but it seems he is vastly outnumber and outmatched.

synopsis: インドに暮らすムスリム女性たちの100日以上にわたる平和的な抵抗運動を追ったドキュメンタリー。 2019年12月、インドのモディ政権はイスラム教徒を意図的に排除する市民権改正法を制定し、イスラム教徒の間では市民権を剥奪される危機感が高まった。法案に対する批判の声が高まるなか、反対運動の拠点であるジャミア・ミリア・イスラミア大学構内に警察が突入し、200人もの負傷者と多数の逮捕者を出した。この暴力的な対応と差別的な法案への抗議として、ニューデリー南部のイスラム教徒居住区シャヒーン・バーグで大規模な座り込みが始まる。その中心にいたのはムスリムの女性たちで、政府による宗教差別やデモ鎮圧は憲法違反だと主張し、日々の暮らしを営みながら100日以上にわたり幹線道路を封鎖した。この非暴力の運動は多くの人々の共感を呼び、世代や文化、宗教を越えてインド全土に広まった。しかしデリー議会選挙をきっかけに状況は緊迫し、警察による強制排除が起こる。 ムスリム女性のノウシーン・ハーンが監督を務め、政治的にも社会的にも透明化されてきたムスリム女性たちによる歴史的抵抗運動の軌跡に、自らの解放と変革の物語を重ねながら描き出す。山形国際ドキュメンタリー映画祭2023にて市民賞（観客賞）を受賞（映画祭上映時タイトル「我が理想の国」）。
synopsis_en: A documentary following over 100 days of peaceful resistance by Muslim women living in India. In December 2019, India's Modi government enacted the Citizenship Amendment Act, which deliberately excludes Muslims, heightening fears among Muslims of losing their citizenship. As criticism of the bill grew, police stormed the campus of Jamia Millia Islamia University, a protest hub, injuring 200 people and making numerous arrests. In protest against this violent response and the discriminatory law, a massive sit-in began in Shaheen Bagh, a Muslim neighborhood in South Delhi. At its center were Muslim women who, arguing that the government's religious discrimination and crackdown on protests were unconstitutional, blocked a major highway for over 100 days while continuing their daily lives. This nonviolent movement resonated with many, spreading across India beyond generations, cultures, and religions. However, tensions escalated around the Delhi legislative elections, leading to a forced police eviction. Directed by Muslim woman Nousheen Khan, the film traces the historical resistance movement by Muslim women, who have been politically and socially rendered invisible, while overlaying her own story of liberation and transformation. It won the Audience Award at the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2023 (screened under the title 'My Ideal Country').

synopsis: お転婆なヒロイン像やライバル魔女の登場など「魔女っ子」ものの転換点となった作品。荒木伸吾デザインのスラリとしたキャラクター、土田勇によるヨーロッパ風の街並み、恋多きメグなど、企画時の「綺麗に可愛く小粋に」のスローガンが実現されている。原作のひろみプロ、演出の坂口尚など虫プロの人材も合流した。最終回、メグを別離に追い込む芹川有吾の演出が見事。全72話。
synopsis_en: A work that marked a turning point in the "witch girl" genre, featuring a tomboyish heroine and the introduction of a rival witch. The sleek character designs by Shingo Araki, the European-style cityscapes by Isamu Tsuchida, and the romance-filled Meg all realized the planning slogan of "beautiful, cute, and chic." Talent from Mushi Production, including the original creator Hiromi Pro and director Susumu Sakaguchi, also joined the project. The final episode, directed by Yugo Serikawa, masterfully drives Meg into a heartbreaking farewell. 72 episodes total.

synopsis_en: An ambitious work based on the fairy tale "The Little Mermaid," incorporating romantic elements to raise the target age range from the traditional witch girl series. Frankie, in his famous partnership with Kawashima, plays a laid-back jack-of-all-trades who works as a ghostwriter and konnyaku maker. With unique supporting actors like Naniwa and Ozawa, this is a brilliant ensemble comedy that leaves a lasting impression.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1960年代神戸—日本で生まれたベルギー人の小さな女の子アメリ。彼女の成長を描く物語。外交官の家庭に生まれ、2歳半までは無反応状態だったアメリ。その後、子ども時代に突入した彼女は自らを「神」だと信じ、魔法のような世界を生きている。家政婦のニシオさんや家族との日々の生活は、彼女にとって冒険であり、新たな発見の連続。少しずつ変化していくアメリ。しかし、3歳の誕生日に人生を変える出来事が起こり、彼女の世界は大きく変わっていく…。誰もが子供時代に夢見た世界を描く感動のアニメーション作品
tmdb_overview_en: The world is a perplexing, peaceful mystery to Amélie until a miraculous encounter with chocolate ignites her wild sense of curiosity. As she develops a deep attachment to her family's housekeeper, Nishio-san, Amélie discovers the wonders of nature as well as the emotional truths hidden beneath the surface of her family's idyllic life as foreigners in post-war Japan.
movie_title_original: Amélie et la métaphysique des tubes
movie_title_en: Little Amélie or the Character of Rain
synopsis_en: An animated film set in 1960s Kobe, depicting the growth of Amélie, a Belgian girl born in Japan. Based on the autobiographical novel "Tube Metaphysics" by Belgian writer Amélie Nothomb, it portrays a world rich in emotion, seen through the eyes of the two-year-old protagonist Amélie, woven with life, color, and her witty words. In 1960s Kobe, Amélie, a Belgian girl born into a diplomat's family, is unresponsive until age two and a half, but then enters an invincible childhood, believing herself to be a god and living in a magical world. Her days with her beloved housekeeper Nishio and her family are adventures full of new discoveries. One day, she learns the kanji for "rain," which suits her perfectly. Then, on her third birthday, an event occurs that changes everything. Directed by Myriam Ballard and Liang-Cho Han, who worked on "Long Way North," with music by Japanese composer Mari Fukuhara. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Annecy International Animated Film Festival and was nominated for Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.

country: インド 原題または英題：Kandukondain Kandukondain
synopsis: イギリスの女性作家ジェーン・オースティンが1811年に発表した小説「分別と多感」を、舞台を現代の南インドに移して映画化した恋愛ドラマ。「響け！情熱のムリダンガム」の監督ラージーブ・メーナンと音楽のA・R・ラフマーンのコンビが2000年に手がけた。 南インド・タミルナードゥ州の由緒ある名家。慎ましく聡明な姉ソウミャは学校の校長を務め、詩と南インド古典音楽を愛する奔放な妹ミーナクシは夢見るように日々を過ごしていた。しかし祖父の死をきっかけに屋敷は遠縁の手に渡り、母と娘たちは大都会チェンナイで新たな生活を始めることになる。妹の前には詩を愛する若き実業家と、内戦で片足を失い花を育てて生きる元軍人が現れ、姉の前には映画監督を志す男が現れる。それぞれの恋と仕事のなかで、姉妹は自分の人生を一つずつ見つけていく。 姉ソウミャを「その名にちなんで」「ライフ・オブ・パイ　トラと漂流した227日」で知られるタブー、妹ミーナクシを「ロボット」のアイシュワリヤー・ラーイ・バッチャンが演じ、アジット・クマール、マンムーティ、アッバースが共演。
synopsis_en: A romantic drama adapting Jane Austen's 1811 novel 'Sense and Sensibility,' relocated to modern-day South India. Directed by Rajiv Menon and featuring music by A. R. Rahman, the duo behind 'Mridangam: The Beat of Passion,' this film was released in 2000. In a prestigious family in Tamil Nadu, South India, the reserved and intelligent elder sister Sowmya works as a school principal, while her free-spirited younger sister Meenakshi, who loves poetry and South Indian classical music, lives in a dreamy haze. After their grandfather's death, the family estate passes to a distant relative, forcing the mother and daughters to start a new life in the bustling city of Chennai. Meenakshi meets a young businessman who loves poetry and a former soldier who lost a leg in war and now grows flowers, while Sowmya encounters a man aspiring to be a film director. Through their respective loves and careers, the sisters gradually discover their own paths in life. Tabu, known for 'The Namesake' and 'Life of Pi,' plays Sowmya; Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, known for 'Robot,' plays Meenakshi; and Ajith Kumar, Mammootty, and Abbas co-star.

movie_title: わたしの聖なるインド
movie_title_jp: わたしの聖なるインド
country: インド 原題または英題：Land of My Dreams
synopsis: インドに暮らすムスリム女性たちの100日以上にわたる平和的な抵抗運動を追ったドキュメンタリー。 2019年12月、インドのモディ政権はイスラム教徒を意図的に排除する市民権改正法を制定し、イスラム教徒の間では市民権を剥奪される危機感が高まった。法案に対する批判の声が高まるなか、反対運動の拠点であるジャミア・ミリア・イスラミア大学構内に警察が突入し、200人もの負傷者と多数の逮捕者を出した。この暴力的な対応と差別的な法案への抗議として、ニューデリー南部のイスラム教徒居住区シャヒーン・バーグで大規模な座り込みが始まる。その中心にいたのはムスリムの女性たちで、政府による宗教差別やデモ鎮圧は憲法違反だと主張し、日々の暮らしを営みながら100日以上にわたり幹線道路を封鎖した。この非暴力の運動は多くの人々の共感を呼び、世代や文化、宗教を越えてインド全土に広まった。しかしデリー議会選挙をきっかけに状況は緊迫し、警察による強制排除が起こる。 ムスリム女性のノウシーン・ハーンが監督を務め、政治的にも社会的にも透明化されてきたムスリム女性たちによる歴史的抵抗運動の軌跡に、自らの解放と変革の物語を重ねながら描き出す。山形国際ドキュメンタリー映画祭2023にて市民賞（観客賞）を受賞（映画祭上映時タイトル「我が理想の国」）。
synopsis_en: A documentary following over 100 days of peaceful resistance by Muslim women living in India. In December 2019, India's Modi government enacted the Citizenship Amendment Act, which deliberately excludes Muslims, heightening fears among Muslims of losing their citizenship. As criticism of the bill grew, police stormed the campus of Jamia Millia Islamia University, a protest hub, injuring 200 people and making numerous arrests. In protest against this violent response and the discriminatory law, a massive sit-in began in Shaheen Bagh, a Muslim neighborhood in South Delhi. At its center were Muslim women who, arguing that the government's religious discrimination and crackdown on protests were unconstitutional, blocked a major highway for over 100 days while continuing their daily lives. This nonviolent movement resonated with many, spreading across India beyond generations, cultures, and religions. However, tensions escalated around the Delhi legislative elections, leading to a forced police eviction. Directed by Muslim woman Nousheen Khan, the film traces the historical resistance movement by Muslim women, who have been politically and socially rendered invisible, while overlaying her own story of liberation and transformation. It won the Audience Award at the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2023 (screened under the title 'My Ideal Country').

movie_title_en: A Sun-Tribe Myth from the Bakumatsu Era
synopsis: かいせつ 幕末の品川遊郭で一文無しとなった佐平次は…。川島とフランキーの代表作にして、日本映画史に残る名作。幕末の志士や遊女も入り乱れる群像喜劇で、その中を軽妙かつ俊敏に泳ぎ回るフランキーの身ぶり手ぶりが映画の肝を担う。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_jp: 幕末の混沌とした時代、にぎわいを見せていた品川宿の遊郭旅籠の相模屋にひとりの町人・佐平次が訪れる。女郎のおそめを気に入り豪遊するが、実は佐平次は一文無しだった。その翌朝、佐平次は金がないことを若い衆に打ち明けるが、口八丁でその場に居座ってしまう。そして金を返済するためと相模屋で番頭まがいの仕事を始めた佐平次は、下働きから女郎衆、遊郭に出入りする人々のトラブルを持ち前の度胸と機転で解決してみせ、さらにお礼の金をしっかりためこんでいた。また、相模屋に逗留し攘夷の計画を練る長州藩士の高杉晋作、久坂玄瑞らとも交友を深め、いつしか佐平次は遊郭内で一目置かれる存在になっていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Saheji, a man-about-town, gets stuck at a high-class brothel when he can’t pay the bill. He makes the best of his situation by performing various tasks amidst the tumult of the end of the shogunate—but always by making sure to get a “commission” for his troubles.
synopsis_en: Saheiji, left penniless at a Shinagawa pleasure quarter at the end of the Edo period... A masterpiece by Kawashima and Frankie, and a classic in Japanese film history. In this ensemble comedy where late-Edo period patriots and courtesans mingle, Frankie's light and agile movements as he navigates through the chaos are the film's core.

synopsis: かいせつ 舞台は大阪の東、平野川のほとりにあるスラム街。鉄くず泥棒で生計をたてる通称“アパッチ族”の面々と、彼らに寄り添おうと奮闘する町医者フランキーの交流を描いたヒューマンドラマの佳品。妻役・新珠三千代もみごとな存在感。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_en: 1962 Japanese movie
synopsis_en: Set in a slum along the Hirano River in eastern Osaka. A fine human drama depicting the interactions between the so-called 'Apache tribe,' who make a living by stealing scrap metal, and a town doctor (Frankie) who strives to stand by them. Michiyo Aratama, playing his wife, also delivers a remarkable presence.

synopsis: かいせつ 東北のある町で公害問題が持ち上がり、報道合戦が過熱するが―。フランキーが新聞記者に扮し、田舎ならではの立ち回りの難しさに苦悩しながらも、地元密着の記事づくりに情熱を燃やす記者たちの奮闘を描いた秀作。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
synopsis_en: A pollution issue arises in a town in the Tohoku region, and the media war heats up... An excellent film in which Frankie plays a newspaper reporter, depicting the struggles of journalists who, while grappling with the difficulties of maneuvering in a rural setting, burn with passion for producing community-focused articles.

synopsis: かいせつ 自宅で仕事をすることが多い新米パパ(フランキー)が、わんぱくな幼子に振り回されながらも愛情たっぷりに育児に励む日々を描いた異色のホームドラマ。妻役・池内との相性も良く、伴淳・三木のダメおやじぶりも愉快。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
synopsis_en: An unconventional home drama depicting the daily life of a new father (Frankie), who works from home and is run ragged by his mischievous toddler yet raises him with abundant love. His chemistry with his on-screen wife Ikeuchi is excellent, and Bando and Miki are amusing as hopeless fathers.

tmdb_overview_en: Saheji, a man-about-town, gets stuck at a high-class brothel when he can’t pay the bill. He makes the best of his situation by performing various tasks amidst the tumult of the end of the shogunate—but always by making sure to get a “commission” for his troubles.
synopsis_en: Saheiji, left penniless at a Shinagawa pleasure quarter at the end of the Edo period... A masterpiece by Kawashima and Frankie, and a classic in Japanese film history. In this ensemble comedy where late-Edo period patriots and courtesans mingle, Frankie's light and agile movements as he navigates through the chaos are the film's core.

synopsis: かいせつ 舞台は大阪の東、平野川のほとりにあるスラム街。鉄くず泥棒で生計をたてる通称“アパッチ族”の面々と、彼らに寄り添おうと奮闘する町医者フランキーの交流を描いたヒューマンドラマの佳品。妻役・新珠三千代もみごとな存在感。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_en: 1962 Japanese movie
synopsis_en: Set in a slum along the Hirano River in eastern Osaka. A fine human drama depicting the interactions between the so-called 'Apache tribe,' who make a living by stealing scrap metal, and a town doctor (Frankie) who strives to stand by them. Michiyo Aratama, playing his wife, also delivers a remarkable presence.

synopsis: かいせつ 東北のある町で公害問題が持ち上がり、報道合戦が過熱するが―。フランキーが新聞記者に扮し、田舎ならではの立ち回りの難しさに苦悩しながらも、地元密着の記事づくりに情熱を燃やす記者たちの奮闘を描いた秀作。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
synopsis_en: A pollution issue arises in a town in the Tohoku region, and the media war heats up... An excellent film in which Frankie plays a newspaper reporter, depicting the struggles of journalists who, while grappling with the difficulties of maneuvering in a rural setting, burn with passion for producing community-focused articles.

synopsis: かいせつ 自宅で仕事をすることが多い新米パパ(フランキー)が、わんぱくな幼子に振り回されながらも愛情たっぷりに育児に励む日々を描いた異色のホームドラマ。妻役・池内との相性も良く、伴淳・三木のダメおやじぶりも愉快。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー

movie_title_en: I Want to Be a Shellfish
synopsis: かいせつ 復員した田舎町の理髪店主は、思いがけず戦犯として裁かれることになる―。芸術祭賞受賞のテレビドラマを、脚本の橋本が自ら監督した映画版。戦争の不条理と残酷さを描き、フランキーの渾身の演技に心震える伝説的作品。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_en: On a post-war peaceful day in Japan, Toyomatsu Shimizu, a barber as well as a good father and husband, is suddenly arrested by the Prefectural Police as a war criminal and sued for murder.
synopsis_en: A small-town barber who has returned from the war unexpectedly finds himself put on trial as a war criminal. This film version, directed by screenwriter Hashimoto himself, is based on a television drama that won an Art Festival Award. A legendary work that portrays the absurdity and cruelty of war, with Frankie's heartfelt performance that shakes the soul.

synopsis: かいせつ 大学の落研から落語の世界に飛び込み、一躍人気者となった新人落語家は…。芸の世界での修行の苦労、思わぬ成功と挫折を、愉快にほろ苦く綴った佳篇。天性の芸達者・フランキーが、板についた見事な噺家ぶりをみせる。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
synopsis_en: A new rakugo performer who jumps from his university comedy club into the world of rakugo and becomes an instant hit... This delightful and bittersweet film gently chronicles the hardships of training in the world of performance, unexpected success, and setbacks. The naturally gifted entertainer Frankie gives a superb and convincing portrayal of a storyteller.

synopsis: かいせつ 五輪開催間近の東京で外国人観光客の争奪戦に奮闘するサラリーマンを描いた和製ミュージカルの最高峰。全編で芸達者たちが歌い踊り、フランキーの驚異の身体能力にも舌を巻くばかりで、中でも「男いっぴき」での大群舞は圧巻。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_en: A group of friends try to find success in corporate Japan.
synopsis_en: The pinnacle of Japanese musicals, depicting a salaryman struggling in the battle for foreign tourists in Tokyo just before the Olympics. Throughout the film, talented performers sing and dance, and Frankie's astonishing physical abilities leave you in awe. The grand group dance in 'Man Alone' is especially breathtaking.

synopsis: かいせつ 女占い師が大地震を予言、東京の下町の足袋職人は避難を訴え、悪徳金融業者はひと儲けを企み…。関東大震災から50年、「日本沈没」ブームに沸くニッポンを過激に笑いとばす地震狂騒曲。フランキー、財津のコンビはやはり最高！
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
synopsis_en: A female fortune teller predicts a major earthquake, a tabi craftsman in downtown Tokyo urges evacuation, and a shady loan shark schemes to make a quick profit... Fifty years after the Great Kanto Earthquake, this earthquake frenzy comedy wildly laughs at a Japan caught up in the 'Japan Sinks' boom. The duo of Frankie and Zaitsu is simply the best!
